name: Antlion
description: The pan's heavy wave body, and the one that hides. A fat timber-coloured grub seen from above, banded in rust, with six stubs and a head at +x that is almost entirely jaw: two long husk sickles curving in on each other, each with a lit ember tip, because the tips are the only part of it that shows when it is under. Which it usually is — the game spawns it in the `buried` state (EnemyType.ambush) and swaps to this drawing when it comes up: `buried` removes the body and leaves a mound of paler sand with a ripple breathing round it and the two tips standing out of the top, playing `creep`. `elite_buried` is the elite patch and the buried patch in one, because a variant is a patch on the base and the game cannot stack two. Drawn facing +x, mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 11. The `death` clip snaps the jaws once on nothing and lets them fall open; a body killed while buried comes up to play it.

elite.description: Marked by the hive: bleached shell, bone jaws, a brighter organ and hotter tips.

buried.description: Under the sand: the body is gone and what is left is a mound with a ripple breathing round it and the two lit jaw tips standing out of the top. The state the game spawns it in (EnemyType.ambush); it plays `creep`.

elite_buried.description: The marked body under the sand — the elite patch and the buried patch written out together, because a variant patches the base and two of them cannot be stacked. Hotter tips and a paler mound.

crawl.description: six stubs walk in tripods, the body sways on the step, the tail wags, and the jaws open and close on the head's own hinge

creep.description: under the sand: a ripple breathes around the mound and the two jaw tips work above it

death.description: the jaws snap shut once on nothing and fall slack open, the six stubs fold in under the body as it deflates, the tail curls, the lit tips go dark and the organ flares out
